observed: pre553_issued_workload.admit precedes source_factory but not the prior bundle decode
decisions.why_not_invented: No existing exact source-read authorization type or pre-decode scope contract was found. Using IssuedWorkloadRecord before projection would be circular and would fabricate order.

proposed_contract.name: IssuedSourceReadGrant
proposed_contract.enforcement_owner: physical decoder / source byte custody owner
proposed_contract.required_order: authenticate grant -> open/read exact source -> decode -> materialize -> issue workload record -> admit -> execute
proposed_contract.refusal_effect: no source open/read/decode and no source_factory call
proposed_contract.must_not: be generated by this repair or replaced by a synthetic ORIGINAL_SOURCE_GRANTED label

dependent_probes: pre-decode refusal must occur before decode_sav/decode_dta
same source SHA/host/purpose must be checked
revoked/foreign/expired grant must not open bytes

observed: pre553_universal_workload.compile_governed_frontier/execute_governed_frontier are the existing frontier path but use the test-only issuance
decisions.why_not_invented: No existing external production DISCOVERY_FRONTIER authority/frontier issuance contract is accepted by these owners. Accepting a discovery ref without exact external issuance would be an accepted-but-unused parameter.

proposed_contract.name: ProductionDiscoveryIssuance
fields: candidate grammar/frontier refs and complete declared frontier
query/predicate objects and expected candidate keys/jobs
proposed_contract.enforcement_owner: existing native workload/frontier owners plus I05
proposed_contract.required_proof: one bounded external-authority discovery through I05 with native receipts, no-drop, source/grammar/refusal/restore
proposed_contract.must_not: rename TEST_ONLY authority, narrow the frontier, or claim unused discovery refs

source_authority_scope_note: The seven source-level authorities are checked for exact source SHA and role before materialization. Exact universe refs cannot be bound into those snapshots before projection because projection universe identities embed the authority content hashes; explicit foreign universes are still refused at production catalog/execution gates, and query authority universes/risk are exact.
